verses.text: I love the LORD, because He hears My voice [and] my supplications.
verses.textZh: 我愛耶和華，因為他聽了我的聲音和我的懇求。

verses.text: Because He has inclined His ear to me, Therefore I shall call [upon Him] as long as I live.
verses.textZh: 他既向我側耳，我一生要求告他。

verses.text: The cords of death encompassed me And the terrors of Sheol came upon me; I found distress and sorrow.
verses.textZh: 死亡的繩索纏繞我；陰間的痛苦抓住我；我遭遇患難愁苦。

verses.text: Then I called upon the name of the LORD: 'O LORD, I beseech You, save my life!'
verses.textZh: 那時，我便求告耶和華的名，說：耶和華啊，求你救我的靈魂！

verses.text: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; Yes, our God is compassionate.
verses.textZh: 耶和華有恩惠，有公義；我們的神以憐憫為懷。

verses.text: The LORD preserves the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.
verses.textZh: 耶和華保護愚人；我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。

verses.text: Return to your rest, O my soul, For the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.textZh: 我的心哪！你要仍歸安樂，因為耶和華用厚恩待你。

verses.text: For You have rescued my soul from death, My eyes from tears, My feet from stumbling.
verses.textZh: 主啊，你救我的命免了死亡，救我的眼免了流淚，救我的腳免了跌倒。

verses.text: I shall walk before the LORD In the land of the living.
verses.textZh: 我要在耶和華面前行活人之路。

verses.text: I believed when I said, 'I am greatly afflicted.'
verses.textZh: 我因信，所以如此說話；我受了極大的困苦。

verses.text: I said in my alarm, 'All men are liars.'
verses.textZh: 我曾急促地說：人都是說謊的！

verses.text: What shall I render to the LORD For all His benefits toward me?
verses.textZh: 我拿甚麼報答耶和華向我所賜的一切厚恩？

verses.text: I shall lift up the cup of salvation And call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 我要舉起救恩的杯，稱揚耶和華的名。

verses.text: I shall pay my vows to the LORD, Oh [may it be] in the presence of all His people.
verses.textZh: 我要在他眾民面前向耶和華還我的願。

verses.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD Is the death of His godly ones.
verses.textZh: 在耶和華眼中，看聖民之死極為寶貴。

verses.text: O LORD, surely I am Your servant, I am Your servant, the son of Your handmaid, You have loosed my bonds.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我真是你的僕人；我是你的僕人，是你婢女的兒子。你已經解開我的綁索。

verses.text: To You I shall offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving, And call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 我要以感謝為祭獻給你，又要求告耶和華的名。

verses.text: I shall pay my vows to the LORD, Oh [may it be] in the presence of all His people,
verses.textZh: 我要在他眾民面前，在耶和華殿的院內，在耶路撒冷當中，向耶和華還我的願。你們要讚美耶和華！

verses.text: In the courts of the LORD'S house, In the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
